name: skills
description: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
one_liner: Google's own official cheat sheets that teach an AI coding assistant how to correctly set up and use Google Cloud, so it doesn't fumble things like security permissions.
buyer: A cloud consultancy or systems integrator doing Google Cloud migrations who wants to cut the hours its engineers spend on repetitive setup and configuration work.
business_use_cases: A cloud consultancy packages these skills into a faster, AI-assisted 'secure Google Cloud setup in a week' service it sells to startups.
A SaaS vendor building on Google Cloud uses the skills to auto-generate correct IAM and authentication setup, cutting onboarding engineering time per new customer.
A training company builds a paid 'agentic GCP operations' course using the skills as its curriculum.

money_ideas.idea: Bundle the skills into a billable cloud-setup consulting engagement.
Paid certification course on using AI agents for Google Cloud operations.

steal_this: Package one recipe (e.g. the IAM/auth skill) into a one-click 'secure my GCP project' setup service and sell it to early-stage startups for a flat $299.
